name: Self-audit system maturity
description: A 'self_audit' task: score the orchestrator module on 4 maturity signals.
prompt: Score the orchestrator.py module on 4 maturity signals (0-100 each): (1) test coverage — does every public function have a test? (2) error handling — are all error paths logged and surfaced? (3) documentation — do public functions have docstrings? (4) observability — are key decisions logged at INFO? For each, provide specific evidence from the code.
